introduction.title: 1. Introduction
introduction.body: Minsik ("we", "our", or "us") is committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your data when you use our Service.

infoCollected.title: 2. Information We Collect
infoCollected.intro: We may collect the following types of information:
infoCollected.accountInfoBody: When you create an account, we collect your username, email address, and password (stored in hashed form).
infoCollected.usageDataBody: We collect information about how you interact with the Service, including books you read, ratings, reviews, and bookshelf data.
infoCollected.technicalDataBody: We may collect basic technical information such as browser type, device type, and IP address for security and analytics purposes.

howWeUse.title: 3. How We Use Your Information
howWeUse.intro: We use the information we collect to:

dataSharing.title: 4. Data Sharing
dataSharing.body: We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal information to third parties. We may share aggregated, anonymized data for analytical purposes. We may disclose your information if required by law or to protect the rights and safety of our users.

dataSecurity.title: 5. Data Security
dataSecurity.body: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. However, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

dataRetention.title: 6. Data Retention
dataRetention.body: We retain your personal data for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide the Service. You may request deletion of your account and associated data at any time by contacting us.

cookies.title: 8. Cookies
cookies.body: We use cookies and similar technologies to maintain your session, remember your preferences, and improve the Service. You can control cookie settings through your browser, though disabling cookies may affect certain features.

aboutPage.seoDescription: Minsik is a community-driven book discovery and tracking platform that combines community ratings with Open Library data to help you find your next great read.
aboutPage.title: About Minsik
aboutPage.subtitle: A community-driven book discovery and tracking platform for readers who love to explore, rate, and share great books.
aboutPage.whatIsBody1: Minsik is a book platform built for curious readers. It combines powerful discovery tools with a personal reading tracker, community ratings, and a unique collectible book experience — all in one place.
aboutPage.whatIsBody2: What sets Minsik apart is its rating system: every book's score is a weighted combination of Minsik community reviews and Open Library data, giving you the most comprehensive view of a book's quality before you commit to reading it.
aboutPage.featureTrackerBody: Organize your reading life with four statuses: Want to Read, Reading, Read, and Abandoned. Your personal library is always a tap away.
aboutPage.featureRatingsBody: Rate books across 8 sub-dimensions — pacing, emotional impact, writing quality, and more — plus an overall score. Write reviews that help the community discover great reads.
aboutPage.featureCasesBody: Open mystery cases to reveal random books with collectible rarity tiers — from Common all the way to the coveted Legendary. A fun, surprise-driven way to find your next read.
aboutPage.featureDiscoveryBody: Filter by book length, mood, era, quality threshold, and more. Minsik surfaces the perfect match from thousands of titles based on exactly what you're in the mood for.
aboutPage.featureRecommendationsBody: Receive book and author recommendations tailored to your reading history. The more you rate and read, the more precise your suggestions become.
aboutPage.featureProfilesBody: Explore other readers' public bookshelves, browse their ratings and reviews, and discover what the community is reading right now.
aboutPage.featureCasinoBody: Try your luck with three game modes: spin the slots for a random recommendation, open a mystery case to reveal a book with collectible rarity tiers, or crack open a pack of books one card at a time.
aboutPage.howRatingsWorkIntro: Every book on Minsik displays a combined rating — a weighted average from two independent sources:
aboutPage.howRatingsWorkOutro: The two sources are combined proportionally by review count, so books with more ratings carry a more reliable score. On each book's detail page you can always see both scores independently alongside the combined result.
aboutPage.minsikCommunityBody: Ratings and detailed reviews submitted by Minsik users, weighted by the number of submissions.
aboutPage.openLibraryBody: Ratings from the Open Library community — a vast open catalog maintained by the Internet Archive.
aboutPage.dataSourcesBodyPrefix: Book metadata, author biographies, and series information on Minsik are sourced from
aboutPage.dataSourcesBodySuffix: — a free, community-maintained catalog run by the Internet Archive containing millions of titles across every genre and language. The Minsik community continuously enriches this foundation with ratings, comments, and reading records.
aboutPage.ctaBody: Create a free account to unlock personalized recommendations, track your reading, and become part of the Minsik community.

adminPage.title: Admin Panel
adminPage.seoDescription: Admin panel for managing book ingestion.
adminPage.subtitle: Manage book ingestion and database operations
adminPage.importInfo: Trigger an import of Open Library’s monthly data dump. This is a heavy operation that runs asynchronously in the background. Check service logs for detailed progress.
adminPage.importWarning: ⚠️ This operation can take a long time to complete. It runs in the background and does not block the API.
adminPage.cleansingInfo: Runs a full cleanup cycle: removes low-quality books, orphan authors, underrepresented series, orphan genres, and genres with invalid names.
adminPage.cleansingWarning: ⚠️ This operation permanently deletes data and may take several minutes. It runs in the background.
adminPage.reindexInfo: Rebuilds all three Elasticsearch indexes (books, authors, series) from scratch. Useful after large data imports or index corruption.
adminPage.reindexWarning: ⚠️ This is a heavy operation that may take a long time. Search quality may be slightly degraded while indexing runs in the background.
adminPage.homeRecsInfo: Flushes {code} Redis keys for each home category, then re-runs the home recommendation list builder (24h TTL).
adminPage.homeRecsWarning: ⚠️ Synchronous operation. May take several seconds. Home recommendations will be briefly unavailable until rebuild completes.
adminPage.personalRecsInfo: Flushes {code1} and {code2} Redis keys, then re-runs personal refresher for active users.
adminPage.personalRecsWarning: ⚠️ Synchronous operation. Personal recommendations briefly unavailable until rebuild completes.
adminPage.refreshForUserInfo: Flushes and rebuilds only the listed user’s personal recommendation cache (profile, personal home, personal book/author sections).
adminPage.contextualRecsInfo: Flushes {code1}, {code2}, and {code3} Redis keys, then re-runs the contextual precompute job.
adminPage.contextualRecsWarning: ⚠️ Synchronous operation. Contextual recommendations briefly unavailable until rebuild completes.
adminPage.invalidateEntityInfo: Deletes the cached {code} key for one book, author, or series. Cache will be lazily rebuilt on the next request.
adminPage.bowInfo: Deletes the {code} Redis key, then re-runs the selection logic and caches the new pick (7d TTL).
adminPage.bowWarning: ⚠️ Synchronous operation. Book of the week will be briefly unavailable until re-selection completes.
adminPage.confirmDumpImportBody1: This will start importing Open Library’s monthly data dump asynchronously in the background.
adminPage.confirmDumpImportBody2: The import process is heavy and may take several hours to complete. Check service logs for progress.
adminPage.confirmCleanupBody1: This will permanently delete low-quality books, orphan authors, underrepresented series, and invalid genres from the database.
adminPage.confirmCleanupBody2: This action cannot be undone. Check service logs for progress.
adminPage.confirmReindexBody1: This will rebuild all Elasticsearch indexes from scratch. The process is heavy and runs in the background.
adminPage.confirmReindexBody2: Search quality may be slightly degraded while indexing is in progress. Check service logs for progress.
adminPage.confirmCacheRebuildBody1: This will flush all recommendation Redis keys, then rebuild home recommendation lists and the book of the week synchronously.
adminPage.confirmCacheRebuildBody2: Recommendations will be briefly unavailable until the rebuild completes.
adminPage.confirmPersonalRebuildBody1: This will delete all cached personal taste profiles and personal recommendation lists, then rebuild them for active users.
adminPage.confirmPersonalRebuildBody2: Personal recommendations will be briefly unavailable until the rebuild completes.
adminPage.confirmPerUserRebuildBody1Prefix: This will flush cached personal recommendations for user
adminPage.confirmPerUserRebuildBody2: That user’s personal recommendations will be briefly unavailable until the rebuild completes.
adminPage.confirmContextualRebuildBody1: This will delete all cached book, author, and series contextual recommendations, then re-run the contextual precompute job.
adminPage.confirmContextualRebuildBody2: Contextual recommendations will be briefly unavailable until the rebuild completes.
adminPage.confirmInvalidateBody1Prefix: This will delete the cached contextual recommendations for
adminPage.confirmInvalidateBody2: The cache will be lazily rebuilt on the next request for this entity.
adminPage.confirmBowRefreshTitle: Confirm Book of the Week Refresh?
adminPage.confirmBowRefreshBody1: This will delete the cached book of the week and re-run selection synchronously.
adminPage.confirmBowRefreshBody2: Book of the week will be briefly unavailable until re-selection completes.
